objective: Characterize positive middle-name identifications preserving the old scan on every input and derive an exact algorithm and minimal-switch criterion for arbitrary identifications.
status: Proved: The original stage scan decides every activation exactly when all middle variables are distinct. For arbitrary positive joins, reachability on the actual variable names decides in linear indexed time and minimal switch obstructions are occurrence-labelled simple paths plus endpoint blocks.
title: When the stage scan survives and how to decide after it fails
